|lore=“Listen, friend, we didn’t mean to land in that puddle, and if we could get our ship out, we would, but we can’t so why don’t you just...”
|game_text=If opponent just drew a starship or vehicle for destiny, deploy on table and stack that card here. Opponent may place a card (your choice) from your Lost Pile into your hand to place this Effect (and stacked cards) into owners’ Used Pile.
|printings={{Card versions/Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out (Dagobah)}}
|notes=The remastered slip for Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out uses the official text dated 4 December 2006. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The preview list spells the opening word “Awww.” The two 2003 publisher slips and later remaster spell it “Awwww.” Both published texts stack the opponent’s drawn starship or vehicle, and give the opponent the choice to let you recover the card you select from Lost Pile in exchange for clearing the Effect and its stacked card.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 3, slip 27. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time#Cards|Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
* Earlier versions: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf first release sheet of 30 May 2003] and [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf revised sheet labeled 19 June 2003] (old pre-Remaster slips).

=== Publication sources ===
* '''Source publication''' ([[Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out (V) (Virtual Set 5)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 2, slip 27 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “If opponent just drew a starship or vehicle for destiny, deploy on table, and place that card here. Opponent may allow you to take any one card (of your choice) into hand from Lost Pile to place this Effect and any card on it into owners’ Used Pile.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•27” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-27-Awwww_Cannot_Get_Your_Ship_Out-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]).
* '''Source publication''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 27), in the Committee's Remaster template: “If opponent just drew a starship or vehicle for destiny, deploy on table and stack that card here. Opponent may place a card (your choice) from your Lost Pile into your hand to place this Effect (and stacked cards) into owners’ Used Pile.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
|hatnote=This is the current (Remaster) text of this Virtual Original card. For the original 30 May 2003 slip, see [[Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out (V) (Virtual Set 5)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out]].
